subject: [PATCH v2 7/8] selftests/nfsd: add cross-namespace isolation tests

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch adds a new selftest to the NFS daemon (nfsd) that checks for cross-namespace isolation. The test creates multiple namespaces, each with its own nfsd server and filesystem, and verifies that changes made in one namespace do not affect others. It tests various settings and behaviors, including NFSD settings, running servers, and listener management, to ensure they are properly isolated between namespaces.
